Flow.description: Creates a permission set group if it does not exist and assigns permission sets to the group (called by FPS__Assign_Users_to_Group)
Flow.label: Fonteva: Check Permission Set Group

value.stringValue: The permission set group {!groupName} does not exist.

fields.name: confirmCreateScreen_message
fields.fieldText:
• This step lets you assign permission sets and users to Fonteva’s permission set groups.
  • Before permission sets and users can be assigned to the {!groupName} permission set group, the group must be created.

fields.name: createGroupChoice
fields.fieldText: Do you want to create the {!groupName} permission set group now?

fields.name: selectPermissionSetsScreen_message
fields.fieldText:
• Select the permission sets you want to add to the {!groupName} permission set group.
  • If you have custom permission sets that should be added to this group, select them here.
